quest.title: When the West Wind Arises
quest.description: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x425, Mora x25450, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Talk to Sara about her problem

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Sara from Good Hunter!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: What do you think this is, kiddo, a fruit juice store?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph. How rude! Especially since we're here to HELP!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Help? Oh yes, you're the Acting Grand Master's new hotshot helper, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... That's one way of putting it, but—

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Great. Tell Jean I need my quarterly tax return forms then.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: It's time to get Elzer onto doing the accounts again... I must say though, the tax rate on alcohol in Mondstadt is pretty steep.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you really need to get Jean involved with stuff like this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And yet the Dawn Winery is somehow so very rich.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: That's mostly down to Master Diluc's successful business model.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are the accounts with Jean? Does she do bookkeeping now too?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Master Jean personally goes over all the accounts.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: After all, the wine industry is Mondstadt's main source of income. Jean takes great pains to make sure no detail is overlooked.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon never knew that. Jean's job is even harder than it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The Acting Grand Master's hard work indeed makes our lives a whole lot easier.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: We're certainly very lucky, but... to put it bluntly, we just take it for granted that that's the norm now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... How do you sleep at night knowing how much pressure you put Jean under?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: *sigh* When you put it like that I do feel quite ashamed... I suppose I should give her one on the house next time she's here.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Although... I doubt the Acting Grand Master even has the time to spare for that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a poor excuse to deny Jean a free drink...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Come on {NICKNAME}, let's <color=#00E1FFFF>go and see Jean</color>.

talks.objective: Pass the citizens' commissions on to Jean

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Hey, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Margaret! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: My cat's gone missing. Have you seen it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean... Diona?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: No, not her. I imagine Diona's probably still in the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I mean little Princey. Prince was just home, now he's gone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you seriously think Diona was a house cat!?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: This is a bit worrying. What if Prince can't find his way home?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I would love to help, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we are on our way to an urgent meeting with Jean. Sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess we can have a look for your cat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Naw, {NICKNAME}. You're always such a big softie. But aren't we in the middle of something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sara and Charles need our help urgently, too. Let's go and see Jean first.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: You're on the way to see Jean? What a coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thought you were looking for a cat?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Yes, I wanted to see if Jean could help look for my cat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? You want Jean... to help you look for your cat?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: What's wrong with that?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Jean's a really nice person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Such a solid line of reasoning...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I feel like this is a classic case of "good people finish last."

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Please mention it to Jean for me. I'll treat you to a brew at Cat's Tail later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, HEY!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, unbelievable! Guess the case of Prince the missing cat is now added to the agenda for our meeting with Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: *cough*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Master—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, ahh— Master Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Master Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, Jean? Jeany Jean-Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Behold, the Dandelion Knight herself?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh! It's our Honorary Knight. Sorry, I must have been daydreaming.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: How can I assist?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, it's not us who need your help. It's a bunch of other people...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I see. Well, thank you for your service to the people of Mondstadt. *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I have made a note of these commissions in my files and I will... make arrangements...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't miss out anyone's commissions, did we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sara's hilichurls, Charles' tax return, Margaret's cat... Seems that's everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll be on our way then, Jean— Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jean! Are you okay!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How's Jean holding up? Is it serious?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It's just burnout from work stress. She'll be fine after a good old rest.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing her here — she may have tried to keep soldiering on otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not a surprise though, she does have a lot to get through every day.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Poor Jean. She has always been one to push herself too hard while overlooking her own needs.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: This isn't the first time something like this has happened.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She really has it tough doesn't she. Poor Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you really care about Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, ah... You think so? I—I mean, she's the Acting Grand Master and all, we can't have her collapsing all the time now can we...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: S—So y'know, it's not like this is a personal... thing, it's just out of love for— concern for... the greater good! Yes, that's it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's up with Barbara... Weird~

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: #...Anyway, you're an honorary knight, aren't you {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: While the Master is down, the knights should share her burden, no?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a very good point, but... Shouldn't one of the fully-qualified knights do that?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Jean has so much to do, an extra pair of hands can't hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: You should go and check in at the <color=#00E1FFFF>headquarters</color>. Jean will be fine with just me here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon feels like she's trying to get rid of us...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nothing! We'll leave you to it — come on {NICKNAME}, let's go.

talks.objective: Return to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I have been informed about Jean falling ill. On behalf of all of the Knights of Favonius, allow me to express my sincere gratitude for your assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So courteous and polite. This isn't the Kaeya Paimon knows.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha... Well, the circumstances warrant it. This is the Acting Grand Master herself we're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Now, in addition to that thank-you message, there was one other thing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have a job for us?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It's like you read my mind! We have quite a connection, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this the part where you give us our reward?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hahaha. I must say I like your style.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But before we can discuss a reward, there are some things I hope you can assist the Knights with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Things like helping to fill in for Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Right. Although the commissions you reported to Jean have already been handed off to someone else...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...I am concerned that they will not be handled with due care without Jean's personal touch.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So I am hoping that you can help out where you see fit.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I will feel much more at ease knowing that the Honorary Knight is personally overseeing these cases.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You can flatter {NICKNAME} all you want, but answer me this — why don't YOU do it!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha... Oh, I have far more important matters to attend to. There are so many things to... to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph. Fine then. So it's <color=#00E1FFFF>Sara, Charles and Margaret's</color> stuff you want us to help with, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Those are the ones. I appreciate the help. See you later!

talks.objective: Find Margaret and ask about the commission

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: ...So, yours is the cat that went missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Venti! Have you come to help?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Me, here to help you? Why, on the contrary, it is I who needs helping!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon just saw you talking to Margaret about Prince...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Aha! So, Prince is the name of the feline fiend who thieved my spare <color=#00E1FFFF>astral iron strings</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Though it gladdens my heart to see that the free-spirited ethos of Mondstadt is alive and well in creatures great and small... Still, it's a bit audacious!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Haha, Prince is a mischievous little rascal alright!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Spoken just like a parent who chooses to spoil said rascal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Indeed. Just like Barbatos...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahaha, yes, quite... quite... Ahem! Now, let's see about getting ourselves an audience with his little highness, Prince Rascal of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I have a performance tonight, and without my spare strings, I shall have to disappoint my audience.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What would a kitty cat want with lyre strings anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Everyone knows cats go crazy for a ball of string!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy. That makes them extremely durable, so I normally just roll them up in a ball to make them easier to carry.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's a trick of the trade from a traveling bard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The strings contain Anemo energy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That'll help us! {NICKNAME}, it's time for you to use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> again!

talks.objective: Find Charles and ask about the commission

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lisa? Are you here about the tax return?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, hello darling. You're quite right. After I heard about poor Jean, I thought I might lend a hand with some of her more literary duties.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cool, well if we're no longer needed here, we'll be on our way.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh wait a moment... Actually, Charles here was wondering—

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Please, allow me, ma'am.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I just took a rather important order, but unfortunately we've run completely dry and the delivery from the winery is behind schedule.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: If it's not too much trouble, could you go and <color=#00E1FFFF>do something about this logistical nuisance</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's so urgent about this order?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: *sigh* It came in at the last minute. Literally, just a few seconds ago.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Exactly, hence the urgency.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, but my next drink here had better be on the house!

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Heh... I'm positive that next time my boss Master Diluc is here, he'll pick up the tab for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds about right!

talks.objective: Find Sara and ask about the commission

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll set off right away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amber! Are you here to help out with Jean's commission?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh, hi. Yeah, I was just getting ready. Who better than an Outrider to mop up some hilichurls on the delivery route?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sara... What are you still stressing about? I'm an Outrider, and I won't disappoint!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You misunderstand me. I don't doubt your abilities, I'm just overwhelmed at the number of orders piling up in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Another bizarre order came in just now. It's like they're hosting a banquet or something...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *clears throat*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything we can help with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help with the cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Really! You don't mind helping?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That would be wonderful! You really are the Good Hunter's guardian angel.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Yeah well... Those hilichurls are going to be a handful, too.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Well, why don't you take this order. Start by getting the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Are you sure {NICKNAME} can be trusted? It might end up tasting a bit funky...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: We're well past the point of aiming for perfection. This is now a fight to save the Good Hunter's business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A fight?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: For this dish, we need... <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sweet Flowers and three Fowls</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Okay, go and get ready. You too, Amber. I'll be waiting here.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: O—Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Prince! Good boy, that's my Prince, I knew you'd come home to me...

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Thank you, my friend. I thought I was in deep trouble this time. It's a good thing you showed up.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: I'll put in a good word for you with the gentlemen at the winery.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Is it ready? Let me see, let me seeee!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This is a very good effort. I think you really captured the essence of what the dish is all about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we released from kitchen duty now?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Yes, thanks ever so much for your help. Amber should be able to take care of everything else.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you ever get tired of being an adventurer, there'll be a job waiting for you at Good Hunter if you want it!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I already told you, I can take care of Jean on my own. Please help Jean out by completing her tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: The customers are getting hungry. Please be quick.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Jean's overworked? Yes, relatively speaking you guys have a lot more time on your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. It's a black cat you're looking for.
